source: Bring home the bacon with zero fees.
raw:
{
  "literal": "أحضر لحم الخنزير إلى البيت بدون رسوم",
  "adaptation": "جيب الرزق لبيتك بدون رسوم",
  "back_translation": "Bring livelihood home with zero fees",
  "approach": "adapted",
  "notes": "The pork reference in 'bring home the bacon' was replaced with the culturally resonant term 'رزق' (livelihood/provision) to avoid religious sensitivity in Egypt."

literal: أحضر لحم الخنزير إلى البيت بدون رسوم

notes: The pork reference in 'bring home the bacon' was replaced with the culturally resonant term 'رزق' (livelihood/provision) to avoid religious sensitivity in Egypt.
